candidates.visible: Wide shot. A player in a white jumper runs with the ball and kicks it at about f100. Two white-jumper forwards move toward him and end up close together, each with a dark-jumper defender near. candidates.why: Two teaching points: the forwards' spacing before the kick (f96), and nobody from the kicking side at ground level at the contest (f146).

moments.title: Two leads, [[one space.]]
moments.teaching_point: Spacing. Two forwards leading at the kicker into the same space bring both defenders with them and leave one crowded target. Stagger the leads: one up at the ball, one holding deep or using the space the other left.

claims.text: The player in the white jumper on the left carries the ball and kicks it at about f100.
Two forwards in white jumpers both move toward the ball carrier between f76 and f96 and end up close together.
A defender in a dark jumper is within a step or two of each of those forwards at f96.
In frame at f96, the ground to the right of the two forwards, where the nearer one came from, has no players in it.
Leading into the same space gives the kicker one crowded target instead of two.
The kick lands in a contest of four players, two in white and two in dark jumpers, at about f146.
The second forward may have been told to lead there as a decoy.

moments.teaching_point: Positioning at a contest. Both forwards went up; nobody from the kicking side stayed at ground level by the contest, while one defender stayed off it and was there when the ball came out. Someone has to stay down at the fall of the ball.
